hero.title: Xiaohongshu video transcripts, extracted in one click
hero.description: Trigger extraction right on the collected record, no need to sync to Feishu first. You get two outputs: a full transcript for copying and feeding to AI, and a timestamped, sentence-level script that shows exactly when the hook lands, how long the setup runs, and where the turn hits.

items.question: Do I have to set up Feishu to extract transcripts in the extension?
items.answer: No. The raw data lives inside the extension, so you trigger extraction right on the record and the result writes back there, ready to copy or export as CSV/Markdown. Feishu is just one optional downstream destination.

items.question: Why do transcripts need timestamps?
items.answer: Flat text only tells you what was said. A timestamped, sentence-level script tells you when it was said and how long each line runs. For short videos, hook timing, setup length, and turning points only show up on the timeline.

items.question: Which should I choose, the free Feishu path or the in-extension one?
items.answer: For high volume on a budget where a rough transcript is enough, use Feishu plus Alibaba Bailian with its 10 free hours a month. For serious pacing analysis or hard-to-recognize audio, use the in-extension path with its more accurate paid model and timestamped script. We keep both.

items.question: Do I need to download the video first?
items.answer: No. Trigger extraction directly on the collected record, with no video download, no ads, and no jumping between tools.
